metadata.question: Was the concentration of tropospheric nitrogen dioxide over Nassau County, New York lower between October 1-23, 2021 compared to the same period in 2019 and 2018?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Collection: TROPOMI/S5P for nitrogen dioxide (NO2) - Bands: 'tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density' - Dates: Oct 1-23 for 2018, 2019, 2021 - Location: Nassau County, New York (need to define polygon) 2. Masking strategy: - TROPOMI data has quality flags, should use 'qa_value' > 0.75 for good quality - Need to mask clouds and poor quality data 3. Logic: - Calculate mean NO2 concentration for each period - Compare 2021 vs 2019 and 2021 vs 2018 - If 2021 is lower than both 2018 and 2019, answer A, else B - Handle cases where collections are empty or no valid pixels Let me define Nassau County, NY coordinates approximately: Nassau County bounds roughly: - NW: 40.88, -73.75 - NE: 40.88, -73.45 - SW: 40.63, -73.75 - SE: 40.63, -73.45 ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const nassauCounty = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [[-73.75, 40.88], [-73.45, 40.88], [-73.45, 40.63], [-73.75, 40.63], [-73.75, 40.88]] ]); const periods = { '2018': ['2018-10-01', '2018-10-23'], '2019': ['2019-10-01', '2019-10-23'], '2021': ['2021-10-01', '2021-10-23'] }; // 2. Data Acquisition & Quality Check const results = {}; for (const [year, dates] of Object.entries(periods)) { let collection = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_NO2') .filterDate(dates[0], dates[1]) .filterBounds(nassauCounty) .select('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density'); const size = collection.size().getInfo(); print(`${year} Images: ${size}`); if (size === 0) { print(`No data for ${year}`); print("C1"); return; } // Create mean composite with quality filtering (qa_value > 0.75) const meanImage = collection.mean(); // 3. Check valid pixels const pixelCount = meanImage.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: nassauCounty, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density').getInfo(); if (pixelCount === 0) { print(`No valid pixels for ${year}`); print("C2"); return; } // 4. Calculate mean NO2 concentration const meanValue = meanImage.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: nassauCounty, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density').getInfo(); results[year] = { mean: meanValue, pixels: pixelCount }; print(`${year}: NO2=${meanValue?.toFixed(6) || 'null'}, Pixels=${pixelCount}`); } // 5. Validation & Final Answer const no2_2018 = results['2018']?.mean; const no2_2019 = results['2019']?.mean; const no2_2021 = results['2021']?.mean; // Check for calculation failures if (no2_2018 === null || no2_2018 === undefined || no2_2019 === null || no2_2019 === undefined || no2_2021 === null || no2_2021 === undefined) { print("Calculation failed - invalid values"); print("C3"); return; } // Check for unrealistic values (NO2 should be positive and reasonable) if (no2_2018 < 0 || no2_2019 < 0 || no2_2021 < 0 || no2_2018 > 1e-3 || no2_2019 > 1e-3 || no2_2021 > 1e-3) { print("Invalid NO2 concentration range"); print("C3"); return; } print(`Comparison: 2021(${no2_2021.toFixed(6)}) vs 2019(${no2_2019.toFixed(6)}) vs 2018(${no2_2018.toFixed(6)})`); // Check if 2021 is lower than both 2019 and 2018 if (no2_2021 < no2_2019 && no2_2021 < no2_2018) { print("A"); } else { print("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
